query: WITH stopped AS ( UPDATE scan_runs SET state = 'cancelled', finished_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND state IN ('queued','running') RETURNING id ), abandoned AS ( UPDATE scan_tasks SET state = 'skipped', finished_at = now() WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM stopped) AND state NOT IN ('done','failed','skipped') RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stopped) AS "runs!", (SELECT count(*) FROM abandoned) AS "tasks!"
